parent.explanation: The only suffix-bearing cycle is the 6-carbon parent (P-59.2.1.4). The ketone is at C1; numbering compares unsaturation before the complete prefix locant set and citation-order ties (P-59.2.3, P-59.2.5).

components.explanation: methyl specifies the connected alkyl substituent at 2; these locants belong to parent.

The only suffix-bearing cycle is the 6-carbon parent (P-59.2.1.4). The ketone is at C1; numbering compares unsaturation before the complete prefix locant set and citation-order ties (P-59.2.3, P-59.2.5).
The ring carbon at C1 is bonded to oxygen by a double bond (C=O).
